decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer is core to a growing firm meeting its aspirations, so there is no shortfall to trigger problemistic search and slack supports continued maturation.
The numbering software module is a low-cost extension supporting the serialization strategy, and keeping it consumes few resources.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces leverages the firm's ink expertise and broadens its applications, so satisficing favors keeping it.
The CodeScan app is a cheap successor product supporting traceability and digitalization, though as a free app it carries a modest risk of being replaced or discontinued.
Inline code verification is central to the firm's end-to-end traceability direction and complements its coders, so it fits current aspirations.
The layout design software provides common operation across the printer range, and with performance meeting aspirations there is no reason to drop it.
